Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

appc 2.99.0.9000

  • Require terra 1.9.46 or newer for the compressed NetCDF extraction fix, and allow completed AQS refreshes to be reused with options(appc.refresh_aqs = FALSE).
  • Retry transient EPA API failures and resume incomplete AQS refreshes from harmonized state checkpoints without replacing the last complete annual extract.
  • Include Idaho and North Dakota in AQS API refreshes for complete contiguous-US coverage.
  • predict_pm25() now accepts geomarker s2cd objects directly, using their stored dates and retaining the existing list-of-tibbles output.
  • Prepare model generation 3 for January 2017 through June 2026 using geomarker 0.2.0, pinned to release commit 373820d0ab8082f856f7bf0f639f3128111d825a.
  • Share geomarker-backed predictor assembly between the committed training-data script and prediction, preserving input location/date order and duplicates.
  • Keep AQS outcome harmonization and the existing GRF training specification.
  • Remove standalone environmental assessment and installation APIs; use geomarker for those functions. Elevation now comes from USGS 3DEP rather than the v2 PRISM source, so the v2 model cannot be reused with these inputs.
  • Record model generation separately from package version, preserve training provenance, and require matching metadata for local v3 model artifacts.
  • Full v3 training and publication are still required. Documentation does not present v2 predictions or performance as results from v3.

appc 2.0.1

  • Load the PM2.5 model from a portable RDS artifact (#119).

Release notes

appc 2.0.0

  • Release a new PM2.5 model and training data covering January 2017 through June 2026 (#118).

Release notes

appc 1.0.2

  • Switch model serialization from qs to qs2 (#117).

Release notes

appc 1.0.1

  • Add keep_predictors to predict_pm25() to optionally return predictors alongside predictions.
  • Validate buffer arguments and improve the README and vignettes.
  • Retain the existing model, data, and prediction values.

Release notes

appc 1.0.0

  • Retrain the random forest with updated observations, replacing predictions across the entire January 2017 through October 2025 coverage period.
  • Update Annual NLCD to include 2024 data, and update HMS smoke, NARR, and gridMET availability for 2025.
  • Add traffic summaries by vehicle class and NEI point-source assessments.
  • Add AQS Data Mart installation for more recent daily PM2.5 observations.
  • Add force_reinstall for refreshing installed source data.
  • Fix maximum-date validation, update gridMET download URLs, and use EARTHDATA_USER for NASA authentication.

Release notes

appc 0.6.1

  • Fix downloading the latest model when rendering the model-performance vignette.

Release notes

appc 0.6.0

  • Add predict_pm25_date_range() and latlon_to_s2_cell().
  • Cache the loaded model in memory for repeated predictions within an R session.
  • Associate model and training artifacts with the package major version, allowing minor and patch releases to reuse the same model.
  • Add configurable minimum and maximum dates to internal input validation.
  • Update the NLCD fractional-imperviousness download URL.

Release notes

appc 0.5.1

  • Fix the NLCD fractional-imperviousness download URL (#90).

Release notes

appc 0.5.0

  • Extend supported prediction dates through the end of 2024; bulk AQS training observations were available through October 2024 at release time.
  • Add the newer Annual NLCD product as an assessment function, without including it in the model.
  • Distribute MERRA-2 data under dedicated data-release tags rather than package version tags.

Release notes

appc 0.4.0

  • Incorporate available 2024 observations and update the trained model.
  • Fix MERRA source installation using response URLs.
  • Install smoke data from its original source on first use instead of distributing it as a package release asset.

Release notes

appc 0.3.0

  • Add gridMET assessment functions and retrain the model using gridMET weather predictors in place of NARR variables, retaining NARR hpbl.

Release notes

appc 0.2.0

  • Publish the first stable release with a finalized PM2.5 prediction model.

Release notes

appc 0.1.0

  • Publish the initial release for model development.
